text: So my assistant here, I'm noticing that you're responding here sometimes in chat. I haven't been reading any of these. I want to move away from using the VS Code sidebar and start leaning heavily into this AI dashboard. I want to see everything in the dashboard. I'm looking at the dashboard, waiting for updates. I'm not really reading this chat here, and that's what I want to get away from, the walls of text that come through here. It takes a while to read it and figure it out, and it's often too much. I want it to be more interactive. So I can see things as they're being designed, I can get familiar with them, we can work on them and revise them. The whole point there is in the assistant skill, make sure to lean into the UI, the dashboard, using the dashboard cards to create a meaningful interactive user interface. The black border that we have now, no bueno, do not like that at all. What I'm thinking is the cards should be less white and then they lighten when you select it. We still do not have the proper layout that I asked for. I'm going to stop transcribing in this. We need to figure out how to switch over to the new system, but make a log of all these things I've been asking for so that when the new masterminds spin up we can pick it all back up.
